subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Workplace Surveillance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Workplace Surveillance.

hook.text: Your employer can read your emails, track your keystrokes, and watch your screen — legally.

buildup.text: Remote work accelerated workplace monitoring. Bossware tracks mouse movements, screenshots, and idle time.

discovery.text: Companies like Hubstaff and Teramind offer tools that score employee productivity by the minute.

twist.text: Studies show surveillance decreases trust and creativity. Watched employees do less, not more.

climax.text: Workplace surveillance treats employees as suspects. The data says it hurts the companies using it.

punchline.text: Watch every keystroke. Lose every ounce of trust.

quiz.question: What effect does workplace surveillance have on employees?
